verdict.rationale: Docs reference a 'Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle' capability and data-quality enforcement, implying some in-pipeline transformation/enrichment exists, but there is no detail on whether this supports custom code or functions versus simple rule-based filters/mappings. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom code/function support (e.g., scripting, serverless functions), examples of enrichment logic, and independent confirmation of developer-defined transformation logic.
